bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 48,000 subscribers. A $5 membership.
beats.text: Your “organize your money in one afternoon” video passed 11,000 views and you have 48,500 subscribers. What people can buy from you is binders, savings challenge sets and a $5 membership.

beats.title: They follow your system, not just your binders.
beats.text: People watch you set up your money binders every month and budget on one income. The system is what they want to copy, and it's yours.

beats.title: Products need huge volume. Help doesn't.
beats.text: Your own video talks about five months trying to save the shop. Binders and a $5 membership only work at large numbers, while the people who want help setting up their system have nothing to buy that includes you.

beats.title: “My audience is on a low income.” So is the programme.
beats.text: Small groups keep the price fair, and the application makes sure people can afford it and are ready. A handful of members a month adds more than a lot of binders.
beats.quote: “my mission is to share the ups and downs of budgeting and starting a business on a low income.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have your monthly income and your list of bills ready.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Jordan

preCallEmails.subject: Every dollar gets a job
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Zero-based budgeting isn't about having more money. It's about deciding where it goes before the month starts.

That's what we'll set up together.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Jordan

preCallEmails.subject: "I already have the binders"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Great, that's the hardware.

The programme is the setup and the weekly check-ins, so the system actually works on your income.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Jordan

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Jordan

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Jordan's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Jordan

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Jordan
